statement: RunPod's Secure Cloud on-demand rental starts at $2.89/hr for H100 PCIe and runs to $6.79/hr for B200, with the page's September 2026 repricing described as lifting the mid and frontier bands.
why: Published rental rates are the clearest same-day read on what renting an accelerator costs, and the page states its own recent repricing moved the mid and frontier tiers up; rental price is a display overlay, not a scoring signal.

impact.mechanism: Neocloud list rates set the cost of rented compute; as a price level this is displayed alongside the index rather than scored into it.

evidence.excerpt: states the September 2026 repricing 'lifted the mid and frontier bands of the Secure Cloud card.'

confidence.basis: Rates read directly off the operator's own published pricing page, but one provider only and the Community Cloud tier was not fully resolved.

dispersion: Secure Cloud spans $2.89/hr (H100 PCIe) to $6.79/hr (B200); Community Cloud described as roughly $0.60-$2.00/hr below Secure Cloud for the same models, exact figures unresolved.
